records.empty: No time entries yet. Start the timer to create your first one.

editor.futureStart: Start can't be in the future
editor.invalidDateTime: Use yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, or just HH:mm to keep the same date

projects.title: Projects
projects.aliasHint: Short code used to auto-fill this project when pasting "#task - CODE - description"
projects.deleteConfirm: Delete this project? Existing entries will keep it as an unassigned reference.
projects.empty: No projects yet. Create one to start tracking time against it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.startWithSystemDescription: Launch Chronos automatically on login, minimized to the tray.
settings.globalShortcutDescription: Start/stop the timer from anywhere, even when Chronos isn't focused. Works alongside the tray icon's menu.
settings.shortcutInvalid: Couldn't register that shortcut — it may already be in use by another app.
settings.groupSimilarDescription: Combine entries with the same task and description on the same day into one row.
settings.updateReady: Update installed — restart to apply it.
settings.autoBackupDescription: Periodically save a full JSON backup to a folder of your choice. Off by default.
settings.autoBackupRetentionDescription: How many backups to keep before deleting the oldest. Use 1 to always overwrite with just the latest.
settings.dataDescription: Chronos stores everything locally on this device. Nothing is sent over the network.
settings.importJsonWarning: Importing a backup replaces all current data.
settings.resetAllDescription: Permanently deletes every project and time entry on this device. This cannot be undone.
settings.resetConfirm: Delete all projects and time entries? This cannot be undone.
